messages:
dave: Heads-up — Sola Health disputed a Dedicated overage shown on 2026-04 invoice. They say their app was idle during the window. Can billing ops pull the slot-level usage?

maria: On it. Do we have the invoice line reference?

dave: Invoice 2026-04-07, line: DEDICATED_OVERRUN $2,120. They attached a small CSV of timestamps.

billing-bot: Auto-note: Invoice 2026-04-07 for account sola-health (acct_3344). Line items:
```
DEDICATED_COMMIT_MONTHLY  1  $8,000.00
DEDICATED_OVERRUN         1  $2,120.00  (2026-04-03 18:20 - 2026-04-03 19:05)
TAX                       1  $680.00
```

sophia: I pulled the Dedicated pool allocation logs. There's a 45m spike correlated to 2026-04-03 18:22-19:07 with high token emission on host-11. Sample: 
```
2026-04-03T18:23:01Z host-11 req=tx987 model=rw-13b seq=1024 tokens=9500 tenant=acct_3344
2026-04-03T18:23:02Z host-11 req=tx988 model=rw-13b seq=2048 tokens=18000 tenant=acct_7788
```
This shows mixed tenant traffic but the dominant token emitters are acct_7788.

dave: Who is acct_7788?

maria: That's partner-labs internal test account. We have a cross-tenant routing rule that allows partner-labs to spill into dedicated pools when their reserved is saturated. Looks like they fell back into Sola's pool.

ops-bot: Alert created: routing-rule-collision-2026-04-03 assigned to infra-team.

sophia: Based on token totals, ~85% of burst tokens attributed to acct_7788.

dave: Proposed fixes: 1) refund Sola Health the overrun charge; 2) invoice acct_7788 for the overage; 3) update routing policy to add stricter affinity for Dedicated pools, and 4) flag partner-labs for a usage cap. Approve?

maria: Approve. Also recommend a small goodwill credit of $100 to Sola for the disruption.

dave: Approved. Sophia, can you prepare the credit memo and the chargeback?

sophia: Will do. Drafts: CM-2026-04-SOLA-01 credit $2,120.00 + GC-2026-04-SOLA-01 $100. Chargeback invoice CB-2026-04-7788 for $2,120.00.

billing-bot: Action: credit memo CM-2026-04-SOLA-01 issued; new invoice 2026-04-07-v2 generated (overrun line removed).

maria: Notifying Sola support contact and CC infra. Also scheduling a post-incident review next week.

dave: Please ensure acct_7788 gets flagged and we throttle their fallback path until they request capacity increase.

sophia: Noted. I'll add a 24-hour temporary throttle and open a billing dispute with the partner for recovery.

maria: Thanks all. Sola confirmed receipt and appreciated the quick remediation. Filing follow-up tasks in billing-ops board.
